# scripts/ops/Initialize-AvdRunStore.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Sets up the run store once per subscription: durable storage for recorded runs (build/specs/run-recorder-spec.md sections 6.3, 9.2 and 9.3).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-Location` | string | no | `$env:AVD_LOCATION` |  |
| `-TeardownLogs` | string | no | `'Keep'` |  |
| `-PrivateRepo` | string | no | `$env:AVD_PRIVATE_REPO` |  |
| `-AcceptDefenderCharge` | switch | no |  |  |
| `-NoActivityLogExport` | switch | no |  |  |
| `-SubscriptionId` | string | no |  |  |
